metadata.reason: Summarizes the scope of the feature extraction code (audio-to-score alignment, emotional, melodic, harmonic, structural features).

metadata.evidence: For this task, we used a classic approach based on Dynamic Time Warping (DTW).
metadata.reason: Names the core algorithm used for audio-to-score alignment, relevant for reproduction.

metadata.evidence: In particular, we have used the DTW algorithm provided by the [Librosa](https://github.com/librosa/librosa).
metadata.reason: External library dependency used for the DTW alignment.

metadata.evidence: More specifically, the symbolic notation has been converted to audio signal using the [Midi2audio library](https://github.com/bzamecnik/midi2audio).
metadata.reason: External library dependency used to convert symbolic notation to audio.

metadata.evidence: To support the scanning of symbolic representations we reused [music21](https://github.com/cuthbertLab/music21) and [The VIS framework](https://github.com/ELVIS-Project/vis-framework).
metadata.reason: External library dependency for symbolic music analysis.

metadata.evidence: To support the scanning of symbolic representations we reused [music21](https://github.com/cuthbertLab/music21) and [The VIS framework](https://github.com/ELVIS-Project/vis-framework).
metadata.reason: External framework dependency for melodic pattern extraction.

metadata.evidence: For the structural features of the song, i.e. the structure and sections that make up the song, we reused the [MSAF library](https://pythonhosted.org/msaf/tutorial.html), using it directly on the audio signal.
metadata.reason: External library dependency for music structural analysis.

metadata.value: the pitch of the song, the dissonances present in the song, the chords that are formed in polyphonic compositions, the recurrent harmonic sequences
metadata.normalized_value: the pitch of the song, the dissonances present in the song, the chords that are formed in polyphonic compositions, the recurrent harmonic sequences
metadata.evidence:
For harmonic features, we implemented an algorithm to extract several harmonic features, including:
* the pitch of the song
* the dissonances present in the song
* the chords that are formed in polyphonic compositions
* the recurrent harmonic sequences, using a mirror approach to that proposed in the previous section.
metadata.reason: Enumerates the concrete outputs of the harmonic feature extraction algorithm.
